Alex Dietrich
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Alex Dietrich is a German electronic music producer and recording artist associated primarily with French house, French Touch-inspired electronic music, ambient electronica and downtempo. He began releasing music independently in 2026 and is signed to Dimitrium Records, an independent record label based in Požarevac, Serbia.

Dietrich's music is characterized by melodic electronic arrangements, house-influenced rhythms and the frequent use of atmospheric and environmental recordings. His work commonly combines conventional electronic production with sounds including rain, thunder, birdsong, vinyl noise and spoken or whispered vocal recordings.

He is best known for his debut album Unendlich (2026), recorded in collaboration with Nala the Cat, who is credited as a co-producer despite having no documented knowledge of music production.

Career

2026–present: Unendlich

Dietrich began work on his debut studio album, Unendlich, in 2026. The project developed from experiments with French house and French Touch production before gradually incorporating elements of deep house, ambient music, downtempo and other forms of electronic music.

The album's title track, “Unendlich”, was developed as an atmospheric French house composition built around a dance-oriented rhythm and melodic electronic arrangement. It was followed by “Anderswo”, a more club-oriented house track emphasizing rhythm and momentum.

The third track, “Flüstern”, represented a departure from the faster house-oriented material. Recorded at 95 BPM, it combines plucked melodies, chords, pads, strings and whispered German vocals with environmental ambience. The recording concludes with birdsong.

Its ending connects directly with “Schweben”, which begins with birdsong accompanied by distant thunder. The track uses acoustic percussion and a low-register piano arpeggio in place of a conventional electronic bass part. Thunder returns near the conclusion of the recording, although no subsequent meteorological developments have yet been documented.

By September 2026, Unendlich consisted of four tracks with a total running time of approximately 11 minutes and 39 seconds.

Musical style

Dietrich's work is primarily rooted in electronic music and draws significant influence from French Touch, particularly the melodic and atmospheric side of the genre. House music forms the rhythmic basis of much of his early material, although his compositions increasingly incorporate ambient, downtempo and cinematic elements.

The four compositions on Unendlich vary considerably in tempo and arrangement. “Unendlich” and “Anderswo” are predominantly house-oriented, while “Flüstern” and “Schweben” place greater emphasis on atmosphere and slower musical development.

Dietrich has described his own genre with some uncertainty as French Touch, while acknowledging that several compositions depart substantially from the conventions of the genre.

His production process makes extensive use of software instruments and relatively limited production equipment. Much of his early work was produced using stock instruments and effects in FL Studio, alongside KSHMR drum samples and Kickstart 2.

Unlike many sample-based French house productions, much of Dietrich's early work consists of original compositions.

Dimitrium Records

In 2026, Dietrich signed with Dimitrium Records, becoming one of the label's earliest known recording artists.

At the time of signing, Dietrich had little established commercial presence and no significant catalogue of commercially released music. The decision was therefore regarded internally as an unusually strong commitment to an unproven artist.

The signing was facilitated by Aleksa Dimitrijević, the founder of Dimitrium Records. Dimitrijević's role is that of the label's founder; Dietrich is the recording artist and producer of Unendlich.

The exact nature of the professional relationship between Dimitrijević and Dietrich has never been formally clarified by either party.

The signing was later described within Dimitrium Records' own historical documentation as a key moment in the decline of the label.

Association with Nala the cat

Dietrich frequently collaborates with Nala, a domestic cat credited on Unendlich as Nala the Cat.

Nala is listed as a co-producer on the album and appears prominently in artwork associated with the project. Her exact contributions to the recordings are unclear. Contemporary accounts primarily document her presence near computers, musical equipment and Dietrich during production.

Her only known public statement regarding Unendlich consists of the word “Meow.”

The statement was subsequently used by Dietrich as a testimonial for the album.

Nala's image is distributed separately under the Nala Open Image Repository (NOIR) license.

Influences

Dietrich has cited Daft Punk as his principal musical influence. Their influence is particularly evident in his interest in French house, repetition, filtered electronic textures, atmospheric composition and the treatment of electronic albums as cohesive works rather than collections of unrelated singles.

His slower material has additionally drawn comparisons within Dimitrium publications to the more atmospheric portions of Daft Punk's catalogue and to the cinematic electronic music of Tron: Legacy.

There is no known professional relationship between Dietrich and Daft Punk.

item.title: Alex Dietrich
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Alex Dietrich je nemački producent elektronske muzike i izvođač, prvenstveno povezan sa francuskim hausom, elektronskom muzikom inspirisanom French Touch zvukom, ambijentalnom elektronikom i downtempom. Samostalno je počeo da objavljuje muziku 2026. godine i potpisao je za Dimitrium Records, nezavisnu izdavačku kuću iz Požarevca u Srbiji.

Dietrichovu muziku karakterišu melodični elektronski aranžmani, ritmovi pod uticajem hausa i česta upotreba atmosferskih i ambijentalnih snimaka. Njegov rad obično spaja klasičnu elektronsku produkciju sa zvucima kiše, grmljavine, pevanja ptica, šumom vinila i snimcima izgovorenog ili šaputanog vokala.

Najpoznatiji je po debitantskom albumu Unendlich (2026), snimljenom u saradnji sa Nalom, mačkom, koja je navedena kao koproducentkinja uprkos tome što nema dokumentovano znanje o muzičkoj produkciji.

Karijera

2026–danas: Unendlich

Dietrich je počeo da radi na svom debitantskom studijskom albumu Unendlich 2026. godine. Projekat je nastao iz eksperimenata sa francuskim hausom i French Touch produkcijom, pre nego što je postepeno uključio elemente deep house-a, ambijentalne muzike, downtempa i drugih oblika elektronske muzike.

Naslovna pesma albuma, „Unendlich”, razvijena je kao atmosferska French house kompozicija zasnovana na ritmu za ples i melodičnom elektronskom aranžmanu. Usledila je „Anderswo”, haus numera usmerenija ka klubu, sa naglaskom na ritam i zamah.

Treća pesma, „Flüstern”, predstavljala je odmak od bržeg materijala usmerenog na haus. Snimljena na 95 BPM, spaja čupkane melodije, akorde, padove, gudače i šapat na nemačkom sa ambijentalnim zvucima. Snimak se završava pevanjem ptica.

Njen završetak se direktno nadovezuje na „Schweben”, koji počinje pevanjem ptica uz udaljenu grmljavinu. Pesma koristi akustične udaraljke i klavirski arpeđo u niskom registru umesto konvencionalne elektronske bas deonice. Grmljavina se vraća pri kraju snimka, iako naknadni meteorološki razvoji još nisu dokumentovani.

Do septembra 2026. godine, Unendlich se sastojao od četiri pesme ukupnog trajanja približno 11 minuta i 39 sekundi.

Muzički stil

Dietrichov rad je prvenstveno ukorenjen u elektronskoj muzici i u velikoj meri se oslanja na French Touch, naročito na melodičniju i atmosferičniju stranu tog žanra. Haus muzika čini ritmičku osnovu velikog dela njegovog ranog materijala, iako njegove kompozicije sve više uključuju ambijentalne, downtempo i filmske elemente.

Četiri kompozicije na albumu Unendlich znatno se razlikuju po tempu i aranžmanu. „Unendlich” i „Anderswo” su pretežno usmerene na haus, dok „Flüstern” i „Schweben” veći naglasak stavljaju na atmosferu i sporiji muzički razvoj.

Dietrich je sopstveni žanr uz izvesnu dozu nesigurnosti opisao kao French Touch, uz priznanje da nekoliko kompozicija značajno odstupa od konvencija tog žanra.

Njegov produkcijski proces u velikoj meri koristi softverske instrumente i relativno ograničenu produkcijsku opremu. Veliki deo ranog rada nastao je uz pomoć fabričkih instrumenata i efekata u FL Studio-u, KSHMR drum semplova i Kickstart-a 2.

Za razliku od brojnih French house produkcija zasnovanih na semplovima, veliki deo Dietrichovog ranog rada čine originalne kompozicije.

Dimitrium Records

Dietrich je 2026. godine potpisao za Dimitrium Records, postavši jedan od prvih poznatih izvođača izdavačke kuće.

U trenutku potpisivanja, Dietrich je imao malo izgrađenog komercijalnog prisustva i nije posedovao značajan katalog komercijalno objavljene muzike. Zbog toga je odluka interno smatrana neuobičajeno snažnom posvećenošću neproverenom izvođaču.

Potpisivanje je omogućio Aleksa Dimitrijević, osnivač Dimitrium Recordsa. Dimitrijevićeva uloga je uloga osnivača izdavačke kuće, dok je Dietrich izvođač i producent albuma Unendlich.

Tačna priroda profesionalnog odnosa između Dimitrijevića i Dietricha nikada nije formalno razjašnjena ni od jedne strane.

Potpisivanje je kasnije u sopstvenoj istorijskoj dokumentaciji Dimitrium Recordsa opisano kao ključni trenutak u propadanju izdavačke kuće.

Veza sa Nalom, mačkom

Dietrich često sarađuje sa Nalom, domaćom mačkom navedenom na albumu Unendlich kao Mačka Nala.

Nala je navedena kao koproducentkinja na albumu i istaknuto se pojavljuje na vizuelima povezanim sa projektom. Njeni tačni doprinosi snimcima nisu jasni. Savremeni zapisi pre svega dokumentuju njeno prisustvo pored računara, muzičke opreme i Dietricha tokom produkcije.

Njena jedina poznata javna izjava o albumu Unendlich sastoji se od reči „Mjau.”

Dietrich je tu izjavu kasnije upotrebio kao svedočanstvo za album.

Nalina slika se zasebno distribuira pod licencom Nala Open Image Repository (NOIR).

Uticaji

Dietrich je naveo Daft Punk kao svoj glavni muzički uticaj. Njihov uticaj je naročito vidljiv u njegovom interesovanju za francuski haus, ponavljanje, filtrirane elektronske teksture, atmosfersku kompoziciju i pristup elektronskim albumima kao koherentnim delima, a ne skupovima nepovezanih singlova.

Njegov sporiji materijal je u Dimitrium publikacijama dodatno poređen sa atmosferičnijim delovima kataloga Daft Punka i sa filmskom elektronskom muzikom iz Tron: Legacy.

Ne postoji poznat profesionalni odnos između Dietricha i Daft Punka.

item.title: Dimitrium Records
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Dimitrium Records is an independent record label based in Požarevac, Serbia. Founded in 2026 by Aleksa Dimitrijević, the label is associated with independently produced electronic music and with the early recording activities of Alex Dietrich.

Its early public activity became closely associated with the development of Dietrich's debut album Unendlich.

Dietrich also insisted that Nala the cat be signed alongside him. The label accepted the request, formally adding the album's credited co-producer to its early roster.

History

Dimitrium Records was established in 2026 as an independent home for original electronic music. At the time of its formation, the label had little documented commercial infrastructure and a very small public catalogue.

Its early activity focused on material informed by French house, French Touch, ambient electronic music and downtempo.

Alex Dietrich

In 2026, Dimitrium Records signed Alex Dietrich as one of its earliest known recording artists. At the time, Dietrich had little established commercial presence and no significant catalogue of commercially released music. The decision was therefore regarded internally as an unusually strong commitment to an unproven artist.

Dietrich's debut album Unendlich became the project most closely associated with the label. The record consists of four electronic compositions developed with house-oriented rhythms, atmospheric sound design, environmental recordings and French Touch influences.

Operations

Dimitrium Records supports the release and presentation of Alex Dietrich's original electronic music, including material released under the Unendlich project. Dietrich is the project's recording artist and producer.

The exact professional relationship between Dietrich, the label and its founder has never been formally clarified by the parties involved.

Reputation

The signing of Dietrich was later described in Dimitrium Records' own historical documentation as a key moment in the decline of the label. No formal explanation for this assessment has been published.

item.title: Dimitrium Records
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Dimitrium Records je nezavisna izdavačka kuća iz Požarevca u Srbiji. Osnovao ju je Aleksa Dimitrijević 2026. godine, a povezana je sa samostalno produciranom elektronskom muzikom i ranim snimateljskim aktivnostima Alex Dietricha.

Rana javna aktivnost izdavačke kuće postala je usko povezana sa razvojem Dietrichovog debitantskog albuma Unendlich.

Dietrich je takođe insistirao da i Mačka Nala potpiše zajedno sa njim. Izdavačka kuća je prihvatila zahtev i time formalno dodala koproducentkinju potpisanu na albumu svom ranom rosteru.

Istorija

Dimitrium Records je osnovan 2026. godine kao nezavisni dom za originalnu elektronsku muziku. U trenutku osnivanja, kuća je imala malo dokumentovane komercijalne infrastrukture i veoma mali javni katalog.

Njene rane aktivnosti bile su usmerene na materijal pod uticajem francuskog hausa, French Toucha, ambijentalne elektronike i downtempa.

Alex Dietrich

Dimitrium Records je 2026. godine potpisao Alex Dietricha kao jednog od svojih prvih poznatih izvođača. U tom trenutku, Dietrich je imao malo izgrađenog komercijalnog prisustva i nije posedovao značajan katalog komercijalno objavljene muzike. Odluka je zato interno smatrana neuobičajeno snažnom posvećenošću neproverenom izvođaču.

Dietrichov debitantski album Unendlich postao je projekat koji se najviše povezuje sa izdavačkom kućom. Album se sastoji od četiri elektronske kompozicije razvijane uz haus ritmove, atmosferski dizajn zvuka, ambijentalne snimke i French Touch uticaje.

Rad

Dimitrium Records podržava objavljivanje i predstavljanje originalne elektronske muzike Alex Dietricha, uključujući materijal objavljen u okviru projekta Unendlich. Dietrich je izvođač i producent projekta.

Tačan profesionalni odnos između Dietricha, izdavačke kuće i njenog osnivača nikada nije formalno razjašnjen od uključenih strana.

Ugled

Potpisivanje Dietricha kasnije je u sopstvenoj istorijskoj dokumentaciji Dimitrium Recordsa opisano kao ključni trenutak u propadanju izdavačke kuće. Formalno objašnjenje za takvu procenu nije objavljeno.

item.title: Nala the cat
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Nala the cat, commonly known as Nala, is a domestic cat and the companion of Aleksa Dimitrijević. She is credited as a co-producer on Unendlich (2026), the debut album by Alex Dietrich, and is one of the earliest artists signed to Dimitrium Records.

Nala is known for her calm presence during work on music and software. She is frequently found sleeping in elevated places and has been documented sitting with Dimitrijević while he writes code, produces music or works at a computer.

Life and personality

In 2026, Nala was described as being approximately five years old, although her exact date of birth has not been documented. She is regarded as affectionate and gentle, and is particularly associated with sleeping in high places, including the top of a wardrobe.

Her preferred working arrangement involves sitting on a lap while work is in progress. This requires the person beneath her to remain almost completely still so as not to disturb her sleep.

Music career

Nala is credited as a co-producer on Unendlich, the 2026 debut album by Alex Dietrich. Her precise musical contribution has not been formally documented; contemporary accounts instead record her presence near computers, production equipment and Dietrich during the album's creation.

Her sole known public comment on the album is “Meow”, later used as a testimonial for the release. She also appears in artwork connected with the project, including material credited to Alex Dietrich & Nala the cat.

Dimitrium Records

When Alex Dietrich signed with Dimitrium Records in 2026, he insisted that Nala be signed alongside him. The label accepted the request, making her one of its earliest signed artists despite the absence of documented experience in recording, production or contract negotiation.

The decision formalized Nala's association with Dietrich's work and with the label. Her image is distributed separately under the Nala Open Image Repository (NOIR) license.

Things Nala cannot be or do

For all nine of her lives, Nala still has a few genuinely heartbreaking limitations. They are not failures of character; they are simply the cruel boundaries of being a cat.

  • She cannot produce a song in place of Alex Dietrich. She can sit on the keyboard during a session, but this has never resulted in a finished arrangement.
  • She cannot explain the Pythagorean theorem, even when presented with a very convincing triangle of treats.
  • She cannot be a dog. No collar, heroic pose or enthusiastic tail-adjacent movement can change this.
  • She cannot send a professional email to Dimitrium Records; her most reliable written contribution remains a row of accidental letters.
  • She cannot perform a server restore, read a monitoring alert, or distinguish an SSH key from the warmest spot on a laptop.
  • She cannot understand why a closed door exists when she would prefer it to be open.
  • She cannot promise not to shed fur exactly where it will be noticed most.

These limitations have not prevented Nala from becoming an important presence in the household, the label’s mythology and the long-running struggle between workspaces and cat naps.

item.title: Mačka Nala
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Mačka Nala, najčešće poznata kao Nala, domaća je mačka i saputnica Alekse Dimitrijevića. Navedena je kao koproducentkinja na albumu Unendlich (2026), debitantskom albumu Alex Dietricha, i jedna je od prvih izvođačica koje su potpisale za Dimitrium Records.

Nala je poznata po mirnom prisustvu tokom rada na muzici i softveru. Često spava na visokim mestima, a zabeleženo je i da sedi sa Dimitrijevićem dok programira, producira muziku ili radi za računarom.

Život i narav

Za Nalu je 2026. navedeno da ima približno pet godina, iako njen tačan datum rođenja nije dokumentovan. Opisana je kao umiljata i nežna, a naročito je povezana sa spavanjem na visokim mestima, uključujući vrh ormara.

Njen omiljeni raspored tokom rada podrazumeva sedenje u krilu dok je posao u toku. To od osobe ispod nje zahteva da bude gotovo potpuno mirna kako ne bi poremetila njen san.

Muzička karijera

Nala je navedena kao koproducentkinja na Unendlich, debitantskom albumu Alex Dietricha iz 2026. godine. Njen precizan muzički doprinos nije formalno dokumentovan; savremeni zapisi pre svega beleže njeno prisustvo pored računara, produkcijske opreme i Dietricha tokom nastanka albuma.

Njena jedina poznata javna izjava o albumu glasi „Mjau”, a kasnije je iskorišćena kao svedočanstvo za izdanje. Pojavljuje se i na vizuelima povezanim sa projektom, uključujući materijal potpisan imenom Alex Dietrich & Mačka Nala.

Dimitrium Records

Kada je Alex Dietrich 2026. potpisao za Dimitrium Records, insistirao je da i Nala potpiše zajedno sa njim. Izdavačka kuća je prihvatila zahtev, čime je Nala postala jedna od prvih potpisanih izvođačica, uprkos odsustvu dokumentovanog iskustva u snimanju, produkciji ili pregovorima o ugovorima.

Tom odlukom je Nalina povezanost sa Dietrichovim radom i izdavačkom kućom formalizovana. Njena slika se zasebno distribuira pod licencom Nala Open Image Repository (NOIR).

Stvari koje Mačka Nala ne može da bude ili radi

I pored svih devet života, Nala i dalje ima nekoliko zaista srceparajućih ograničenja. To nisu mane karaktera; to su jednostavno surove granice mačjeg postojanja.

  • Ne može da producira pesmu umesto Alex Dietricha. Može da sedne na tastaturu tokom sesije, ali to još nijednom nije dovelo do gotovog aranžmana.
  • Ne može da objasni Pitagorinu teoremu, čak ni kada joj se pokaže veoma ubedljiv trougao od poslastica.
  • Ne može da bude pas. Nijedna ogrlica, herojska poza ni posebno energično pomeranje dela tela blizu repa to ne mogu promeniti.
  • Ne može da pošalje profesionalan mejl Dimitrium Records-u; njen najpouzdaniji pisani doprinos i dalje je niz slučajno unetih slova.
  • Ne može da uradi restore servera, pročita monitoring upozorenje niti da razlikuje SSH ključ od najtoplijeg mesta na laptopu.
  • Ne može da razume zašto zatvorena vrata postoje kada bi ona više volela da budu otvorena.
  • Ne može da obeća da neće ostaviti dlake baš na mestu gde će se najviše primetiti.

Ova ograničenja nisu sprečila Nalu da postane važna pojava u domu, mitologiji izdavačke kuće i dugotrajnoj borbi između radnog prostora i mačjih dremki.

item.title: Aleksa Dimitrijević
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Aleksa Dimitrijević (born 12 March 2000) is a Serbian table tennis player, web developer and creative technologist from Požarevac, Serbia. He is the captain of the first team of STK Bubušinac, where he also leads the club's technical and information-systems development.

Alongside sport, Dimitrijević develops independent web projects and music-related projects. He is the founder of Dimitrium Records, the label of Alex Dietrich.

Table tennis career

Dimitrijević began playing table tennis in 2008. His club career included STK Požarevac and STK Proleter before he joined STK Bubušinac for the 2018–19 season. He subsequently became a long-serving member and captain of Bubušinac's first team.

He competes in regional and quality-league competition and is known within the club for a steady style of play and for sharing experience with younger players. In the 2023–24 Regional League A season, he was recognized as the league's second-best player. That season, Bubušinac finished second and earned promotion to the Kvalitetna liga.

In September 2024, Dimitrijević and teammate Ivan Krstić represented Bubušinac at the Šetonje table tennis tournament and accepted the club's second-place Regional League A trophy on behalf of the team. He has also taken part in tournament administration, including draws, group allocation and event management.

As captain, he has led Bubušinac in league fixtures, including the club's 4–2 victory over Borac of Kumane in October 2024, where he opened the match with a 3–0 win.

Technical work

Dimitrijević is the author and editor of the STK Bubušinac website. His work for the club includes its visual and technical development, a system for recording matches and results, player and league statistics, and the digitization of club and competition data.

His wider work focuses on building websites and self-hosted technical infrastructure. Through Dimitrium, he develops and documents independent web projects, software, visual work and music-related projects.

For STK Bubušinac, Dimitrijević developed not merely a conventional club website but the club's full digital strategy and an integrated system that automatically connects match results, individual rubbers, players, clubs, rounds, seasons, tables, rankings and news. The system was conceived as a non-commercial initiative and a test platform for tools that could eventually be offered to other Serbian table-tennis clubs.

He works in electronics, telecommunications, automation and information technology, combining practical and technical knowledge in the development of these projects.

Self-hosted infrastructure

Dimitrijević maintains a two-server self-hosted setup consisting of Pluto, the primary production server, and Venus, the independent off-site backup and recovery node.

Pluto runs the public services and container workloads, while Venus receives encrypted backups and provides an independent monitoring point and a prepared cold-standby option for selected services. The servers check one another through a private network and send Healthchecks and ntfy alerts to Dimitrijević when a problem needs attention. This arrangement keeps the infrastructure modest, understandable and recoverable without exposing its access details publicly.

Open-source projects

Dimitrijević's public software work includes LibreTT, a free and libre WordPress plugin for table tennis management. LibreTT is designed around open, portable and durable sports data: match results, historical archives, statistics, standardized data structures, import and export workflows, and self-hosted deployment. Its long-term vision includes stoni.rs as a public, community-accessible database for clubs, players, competitions and their history.

LibreTT is distributed under the AGPL, reflecting a commitment to software freedom, auditability, interoperability and resistance to vendor lock-in. The project is intended to remain useful to clubs, players, organizers and the wider table-tennis community without artificial feature gates.

His portfolio also includes Circuit Smart Redirect, a lightweight WordPress plugin for maintenance mode, temporary lockdowns and controlled site access. It redirects non-administrator visitors to a selected page while allowing administrators to continue working; it also supports scheduled maintenance windows, optional subpage access and role-based bypass controls.

Music and Dimitrium Records

In 2026, Dimitrijević founded Dimitrium Records, an independent record label based in Požarevac. The label's early activity is closely associated with Alex Dietrich and the album Unendlich.

Dimitrijević founded and operates the label, while Dietrich is the recording artist and producer of Unendlich. When Dietrich signed with the label, he insisted that Nala the cat, the credited co-producer of Unendlich, be signed as well.

Personal life

Dimitrijević's cat, Nala, is a recurring presence in his work and is credited as a co-producer on Unendlich. She is known for sleeping in high places and for occupying a lap during coding, music production and other desk work.

Aleksa Dimitrijević (rođen 12. marta 2000) srpski je stonoteniser, veb programer i kreativni tehnolog iz Požarevca. Kapiten je prvog tima STK Bubušinac, gde vodi i tehnički i informatički razvoj kluba.

Pored sporta, Dimitrijević razvija nezavisne veb projekte i projekte povezane sa muzikom. Osnivač je izdavačke kuće Dimitrium Records, izdavačke kuće izvođača Alex Dietricha.

Stonoteniska karijera

Dimitrijević je počeo da igra stoni tenis 2008. godine. U klupskoj karijeri nastupao je za STK Požarevac i STK Proleter, pre prelaska u STK Bubušinac u sezoni 2018/19. Kasnije je postao dugogodišnji član i kapiten prvog tima Bubušinca.

Učestvuje u regionalnim i kvalitetnim ligaškim takmičenjima, a u klubu je poznat po stabilnoj igri i prenošenju iskustva mlađim igračima. U sezoni Regionalne lige A 2023/24 dobio je priznanje za drugog najboljeg igrača lige. Te sezone je Bubušinac zauzeo drugo mesto i izborio plasman u Kvalitetnu ligu.

U septembru 2024. godine Dimitrijević i saigrač Ivan Krstić predstavljali su Bubušinac na stonoteniskom turniru u Šetonju i u ime ekipe preuzeli pehar za drugo mesto u Regionalnoj ligi A. Učestvovao je i u vođenju turnira — radu na žrebu, određivanju grupa i organizaciji takmičenja.

Kao kapiten predvodio je Bubušinac u ligaškim susretima, uključujući pobedu od 4:2 protiv Borca iz Kumana u oktobru 2024, kada je meč otvorio pobedom od 3:0.

Tehnički rad

Dimitrijević je autor i urednik sajta STK Bubušinac. Njegov rad za klub obuhvata vizuelni i tehnički razvoj sajta, sistem za evidenciju utakmica i rezultata, statistike igrača i liga, kao i digitalizaciju klupskih i takmičarskih podataka.

Njegov širi rad usmeren je na izradu sajtova i samostalno hostovanu tehničku infrastrukturu. Kroz Dimitrium razvija i dokumentuje nezavisne veb projekte, softver, vizuelni rad i projekte povezane sa muzikom.

Za STK Bubušinac Dimitrijević nije razvio samo klasičan klupski sajt, već kompletnu digitalnu strategiju i integrisani sistem koji automatski povezuje rezultate mečeva, pojedinačne partije, igrače, klubove, kola, sezone, tabele, rang-liste i vesti. Sistem je zamišljen kao nekomercijalna inicijativa i test-platforma za alate koji bi kasnije mogli biti ponuđeni i drugim stonoteniskim klubovima u Srbiji.

Zaposlen je u oblasti elektronike, telekomunikacija, automatike i informatike, gde praktično i tehničko znanje kombinuje u razvoju ovih projekata.

Samostalno hostovana infrastruktura

Dimitrijević održava samostalno hostovan sistem sa dva servera: Plutonom, primarnim produkcionim serverom, i Venerom, nezavisnim udaljenim čvorom za rezervne kopije i oporavak.

Pluton pokreće javne servise i kontejnerske radne procese, dok Venera prima šifrovane rezervne kopije i služi kao nezavisna tačka za nadzor i pripremljena cold-standby opcija za odabrane servise. Serveri međusobno proveravaju dostupnost preko privatne mreže i šalju Healthchecks i ntfy obaveštenja Dimitrijeviću kada je potrebna reakcija. Takav raspored održava infrastrukturu skromnom, razumljivom i oporavljivom, bez javnog izlaganja pristupnih detalja.

Open-source projekti

Javni softverski rad Dimitrijevića obuhvata LibreTT, slobodan WordPress plugin za upravljanje stonim tenisom. LibreTT je zasnovan na otvorenim, prenosivim i dugotrajnim sportskim podacima: rezultatima mečeva, istorijskim arhivama, statistikama, standardizovanim strukturama podataka, import/export tokovima i mogućnosti samostalnog hostovanja. Njegova dugoročna vizija uključuje stoni.rs kao javno dostupnu bazu klubova, igrača, takmičenja i njihove istorije.

LibreTT se distribuira pod AGPL licencom, što odražava posvećenost slobodi softvera, proverljivosti koda, interoperabilnosti i otporu prema vezivanju za jednog dobavljača. Projekat je namenjen klubovima, igračima, organizatorima i široj stonoteniskoj zajednici bez veštačkih zaključanih funkcija.

Njegov portfolio obuhvata i Circuit Smart Redirect, lagan WordPress plugin za maintenance režim, privremeno zaključavanje sajta i kontrolisan pristup. Preusmerava posetioce koji nisu administratori na izabranu stranu, dok administratorima omogućava normalan rad; podržava i zakazane maintenance intervale, opcioni pristup podstranama i zaobilaženje preusmerenja prema korisničkoj ulozi.

Muzika i Dimitrium Records

Dimitrijević je 2026. osnovao Dimitrium Records, nezavisnu izdavačku kuću iz Požarevca. Rana aktivnost izdavačke kuće blisko je povezana sa Alex Dietrichom i albumom Unendlich.

Dimitrijević je osnovao i vodi izdavačku kuću, dok je Dietrich izvođač i producent albuma Unendlich. Kada je Dietrich potpisao za izdavačku kuću, insistirao je da i Mačka Nala, koproducentkinja potpisana na albumu Unendlich, potpiše zajedno sa njim.

Privatni život

Dimitrijevićeva mačka Nala česta je pojava u njegovom radu i navedena je kao koproducentkinja na albumu Unendlich. Poznata je po spavanju na visokim mestima i zauzimanju krila tokom programiranja, muzičke produkcije i drugog rada za stolom.

item.title: Pluto
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Pluto (not to be confused with the dwarf planet Pluto) is the primary self-hosted production server in the infrastructure behind Dimitrium. It is the main machine for running the public services, container workloads and operational work; it is also the server through which this session is being handled.

Role

Pluto is the active, day-to-day node. It runs the Podman containers and databases behind the sites and services, keeps the primary operational journal, and initiates encrypted off-site backups to Venus. Pluto and Venus also check one another over Tailscale and SSH, so that a loss of either machine can be noticed independently.

Hardware and system

Pluto is an HP EliteDesk 800 G3 Desktop Mini (65 W) with an Intel Core i5-7500 running at 3.40 GHz. Its four physical cores, 8 GB of RAM and NVMe storage make it the considerably stronger of the two machines. It runs Debian GNU/Linux 13 (Trixie) on x86-64 hardware.

The internal NVMe drive provides roughly 238.5 GiB of usable capacity: a 229.6 GiB root filesystem, a 976 MiB EFI system partition and about 7.9 GiB of swap. The platform runs multiple healthy Podman workloads, including WordPress and MariaDB services.

Relationship with Venus

Pluto is built for production work; Venus is built to make that work recoverable. Important off-site copies are stored on Venus, while selected services can be prepared there as manually activated cold standby stacks. The two machines therefore form a small self-hosted pair: Pluto provides the primary capacity, and Venus provides the safety margin.

Monitoring and communication

Pluto and Venus communicate across a private Tailscale network and use SSH reachability checks to confirm that the other machine is still responding. No public management endpoint, address or credential needs to be published for that relationship. Pluto keeps the primary operational journal; Venus receives a read-only synchronized copy, which means the record of an incident remains available even if Pluto is the machine affected.

Alerts and responsibility

Each server also sends its own scheduled heartbeat to Healthchecks. That independent signal confirms that the local monitoring schedule itself is still running, not merely that a site happens to answer a web request. If the peer check fails three times in succession, the monitoring workflow sends an ntfy alert to Aleksa Dimitrijević, the person responsible for operating the pair. The alerts describe an availability problem without exposing infrastructure addresses, access details or secrets.

item.title: Pluton
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Pluton (ne mešati sa patuljastom planetom Pluton) je primarni samostalno održavani produkcioni server u infrastrukturi iza Dimitriuma. To je glavna mašina za javne servise, kontejnerske radne procese i operativni rad; preko nje se odvija i ova sesija razgovora.

Uloga

Pluton je aktivni, svakodnevni čvor. Pokreće Podman kontejnere i baze podataka iza sajtova i servisa, čuva primarni operativni dnevnik i pokreće šifrovane off-site backup-e ka Veneri. Pluton i Venera se međusobno proveravaju preko Tailscale-a i SSH-a, tako da se prekid rada bilo koje mašine može nezavisno primetiti.

Hardver i sistem

Pluton je HP EliteDesk 800 G3 Desktop Mini (65 W) sa Intel Core i5-7500 procesorom na 3,40 GHz. Njegova četiri fizička jezgra, 8 GB RAM-a i NVMe skladište čine ga znatno jačom od dve mašine. Pokreće Debian GNU/Linux 13 (Trixie) na x86-64 hardveru.

Interni NVMe disk pruža približno 238,5 GiB upotrebljivog prostora: root filesystem od 229,6 GiB, EFI sistemsku particiju od 976 MiB i približno 7,9 GiB swap-a. Na platformi radi više zdravih Podman procesa, uključujući WordPress i MariaDB servise.

Odnos sa Venerom

Pluton je napravljen za produkcioni rad, a Venera da taj rad učini oporavljivim. Važne off-site kopije čuvaju se na Veneri, dok se odabrani servisi tamo mogu pripremiti kao ručno aktivirani cold-standby stackovi. Zajedno čine mali self-hosted par: Pluton obezbeđuje primarni kapacitet, a Venera bezbednosnu rezervu.

Nadzor i komunikacija

Pluton i Venera komuniciraju preko privatne Tailscale mreže i koriste SSH provere dostupnosti kako bi potvrdili da druga mašina i dalje odgovara. Za taj odnos nije potrebno javno objaviti administrativni endpoint, adresu ili pristupne podatke. Pluton čuva primarni operativni dnevnik, a Venera prima njegovu sinhronizovanu read-only kopiju, pa zapis o incidentu ostaje dostupan čak i kada je Pluton pogođena mašina.

Upozorenja i odgovornost

Svaki server takođe šalje svoj zakazani heartbeat ka Healthchecks-u. Taj nezavisan signal potvrđuje da lokalni raspored nadzora i dalje radi, a ne samo da neki sajt trenutno odgovara na zahtev. Ako peer provera tri puta uzastopno ne uspe, sistem za nadzor šalje ntfy obaveštenje Aleksi Dimitrijeviću, osobi koja održava ovaj par. Upozorenja opisuju problem dostupnosti bez otkrivanja adresa infrastrukture, pristupnih detalja ili tajni.

item.title: Venus
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Venus (not to be confused with the planet Venus) is the secondary self-hosted server in the Dimitrium infrastructure. Its purpose is resilience rather than raw throughput: it keeps off-site copies, provides an independent observation point and can receive selected services as a cold standby node when needed.

Role

Venus receives encrypted Restic backups from Pluto and keeps a read-only operational copy of the shared Pluto–Venus journal. It has manually activated, isolated cold-standby Podman stacks available for selected sites, including Circuit and ETAI. Before an actual recovery start, the newest backup snapshot must be applied to the standby data.

The two machines monitor each other through Tailscale and SSH. This gives the infrastructure a separate network vantage point for detecting an outage and sending an alert, rather than asking the affected server to report its own failure.

Hardware and system

Venus is an Axiomtek eBOX635-881-FL x86-64 Haswell-era system with an Intel Pentium G3320TE processor, 2 GB of DDR3 SO-DIMM memory and a 120 GB SSD. It runs a Fedora-based Linux setup with SELinux enforcing and firewalld enabled.

Its storage is deliberately divided between a 30 GB root filesystem and a separate 80 GB XFS volume at /srv, with additional LVM reserve retained for future changes. The machine is modest, but its separation from Pluto is precisely what makes it useful for backups, monitoring and recovery.

Relationship with Pluto

Venus is the counterpart to Pluto. Pluto carries the primary workloads; Venus protects the ability to restore them. The pairing favors simple, understandable recovery over an unnecessarily elaborate cluster.

Monitoring and communication

Venus is not a passive disk shelf. It communicates with Pluto through the private Tailscale network and performs the same SSH reachability checks in the opposite direction. This two-way design matters: an outage can be observed by a separate machine rather than inferred only from the failing machine itself. Venus also keeps the read-only operational-journal copy received from Pluto.

Alerts and responsibility

Venus sends a scheduled heartbeat to Healthchecks as an independent confirmation that its monitoring routine remains alive. When peer checks detect three consecutive failures, the monitoring workflow sends an ntfy notification to Aleksa Dimitrijević, who maintains the two-server setup. The notification path is intentionally described only at this level: it reports the availability event without publishing endpoints, addresses, credentials or recovery controls.

item.title: Venera
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Venera (ne mešati sa planetom Venerom) je sekundarni samostalno održavani server u Dimitrium infrastrukturi. Njena svrha je otpornost, a ne sirova snaga: čuva off-site kopije, pruža nezavisnu tačku za nadzor i po potrebi može da prihvati odabrane servise kao cold-standby čvor.

Uloga

Venera prima šifrovane Restic backup-e sa Plutona i čuva read-only operativnu kopiju zajedničkog dnevnika Pluton–Venera. Za odabrane sajtove, uključujući Circuit i ETAI, postoje ručno aktivirani izolovani Podman cold-standby stackovi. Pre stvarnog pokretanja oporavka, najnoviji backup snapshot mora da se primeni na standby podatke.

Dve mašine se međusobno nadziru preko Tailscale-a i SSH-a. Tako infrastruktura dobija odvojenu mrežnu tačku koja može da primeti prekid i pošalje upozorenje, umesto da se oslanja na server koji je možda upravo nedostupan.

Hardver i sistem

Venera je Axiomtek eBOX635-881-FL x86-64 Haswell sistem sa Intel Pentium G3320TE procesorom, 2 GB DDR3 SO-DIMM memorije i SSD-om od 120 GB. Pokreće Linux zasnovan na Fedori, sa SELinux-om u enforcing režimu i aktivnim firewalld-om.

Skladište je namerno podeljeno na root filesystem od 30 GB i zaseban XFS volumen od 80 GB na /srv, uz dodatnu LVM rezervu za buduće izmene. Mašina je skromna, ali upravo je njena odvojenost od Plutona čini korisnom za backup-e, nadzor i oporavak.

Odnos sa Plutonom

Venera je par Plutonu. Pluton nosi primarne radne procese, a Venera čuva mogućnost njihovog povratka. Ovaj par favorizuje jednostavan i razumljiv oporavak umesto nepotrebno složenog klastera.

Nadzor i komunikacija

Venera nije pasivna polica za diskove. Sa Plutonom komunicira preko privatne Tailscale mreže i izvodi iste SSH provere dostupnosti u suprotnom smeru. Ovaj dvosmerni pristup je bitan: prekid može da primeti odvojena mašina, umesto da se zaključuje samo na osnovu servera koji možda upravo ne radi. Venera takođe čuva read-only operativnu kopiju dnevnika koju prima sa Plutona.

Upozorenja i odgovornost

Venera šalje zakazani heartbeat ka Healthchecks-u kao nezavisnu potvrdu da njen nadzorni proces i dalje radi. Kada peer provere otkriju tri uzastopna neuspeha, sistem za nadzor šalje ntfy obaveštenje Aleksi Dimitrijeviću, koji održava postavku sa dva servera. Put obaveštenja namerno je opisan samo na ovom nivou: prijavljuje događaj dostupnosti bez objavljivanja endpointa, adresa, kredencijala ili kontrola za oporavak.

item.content:encoded:
Out Now!

*Well, it's technically not out yet since the album is unfinished and I haven't actually uploaded it to any streaming services. Not to mention the bad mix...

Unendlich

by Alex Dietrich & Nala the cat

Including the hits Unendlich and Anderswo, plus the fan favorite Flüstern!

*I am not German; none of the songs have German lyrics—or any singing, for that matter. I just thought giving the songs German names would be cool.

*Well, actually, the song Unendlich has some German in it, but it's just a spoken vocal, so I don't really classify it as lyrics. The spoken vocals are more of a mood and tone setter, I guess.

The brilliant mind behind it all

Well, first of all, I am intrigued that you actually want to know who's behind it all.

So, where do I start? I am a man who likes to brag about the stuff he's done and is proud of, but you'll never hear me say that out loud when talking to friends or family, and that's the reason why this website exists in a nutshell.

Don't worry, while exploring the website, you'll learn plenty of things about the mastermind behind it all.

Yes, that is indeed me in the picture, but through the eyes of AI. I mean, it has done a fine job—I do look similar to that.

The brilliant mind's companion

Of course, every brilliant mind has a companion by his side, and I'm no different.

Nala, my cat, is about five years old (I think; I'm not entirely sure, though). She's a loving, sweet cat who likes to sleep in high places (e.g. the top of my closet).

Probably my favorite thing is when she sits on my lap as I code, produce music, or just sit there. Of course, I have to stay perfectly still so that I don't disturb the sleeping princess.

Actually, even though you can clearly see that the image is AI-generated, it has done a good job of preserving my cat's appearance from the original image.

About the website itself

Proudly powered by WordPress, the engine under the hood that people in IT like to tell you is "outdated."

Probably my first real love, WordPress is an amazing tool that isn't talked about much. So let's talk about it!

Maybe you've tried creating a website of your own on Wix, Weebly, Squarespace or whatever. Welcome to the club—I did too. And sure, I see why people use those: lack of knowledge, lack of caring, or simply because they're good enough for their needs.

Well, WordPress, unlike all those services, is not a service; it's an engine, and its code is free and publicly available, giving people the freedom to shape websites however they want from the ground up.

So yes, go use WordPress. And yes, it's a bit complicated at first, but the learning curve is worth it!

The website wouldn't exist without these

These are my two puppies—codenamed "Pluto" and "Venus"—that host this website.

Ah well, on top of everything I do, I also enjoy the pain of deploying and maintaining servers.

Yes, the image is AI-generated, but the two servers you see in the picture are indeed real. They are just not at the same location, so I had to feed AI images of both servers and combine them into a single picture to help you better visualize my setup.

Both are running stripped-down versions of Linux, with complex tunneling, port forwarding and routing. (I like throwing technical words at you; it makes me sound like I know what I'm talking about.)

If you are wondering which server is which, the top one is codenamed "Venus," and the one below it is "Pluto."

item.title: Početna
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Dostupno sada!

*Pa, tehnički još uvek nije izašao jer album nije završen i zapravo ga nisam postavio ni na jedan streaming servis. Da i ne pominjem loš miks...

Unendlich

Alex Dietrich & Nala the cat

Uključuje hitove Unendlich, Anderswo i miljenika publike Flüstern!

*Nisam Nemac; nijedna pesma čak nema nemački tekst — niti pevanje, kad smo već kod toga — samo sam mislio da bi bilo kul da pesme imaju nemačke nazive.

*Zapravo, pesma Unendlich ima nešto nemačkog teksta, ali to je samo izgovoreni vokal na nemačkom, pa ga ne računam baš kao tekst; rekao bih da taj govor više služi da postavi raspoloženje i ton.

Genijalni um iza svega

Pa, pre svega, zaintrigiran sam time što zapravo želiš da znaš ko stoji iza svega.

Dakle, odakle da počnem? Ja sam čovek koji voli da se hvali stvarima koje je uradio i na koje je ponosan, ali me nikada nećeš čuti da to izgovorim naglas dok razgovaram sa prijateljima ili porodicom — i to je, ukratko, razlog zašto ovaj sajt postoji.

Ne brini, istražujući sajt saznaćeš mnogo toga o genijalnom umu koji stoji iza svega.

Da, to zaista jesam ja na slici, ali kroz oči veštačke inteligencije. Mislim, odradila je sasvim dobar posao — stvarno ličim na to.

Saputnica genijalnog uma

Naravno, svaki genijalni um ima saputnicu uz sebe, pa ni ja nisam izuzetak.

Nala, moja mačka, ima oko pet godina (mislim, mada nisam potpuno siguran). Umiljata je i slatka, i voli da spava na visokim mestima (na primer, na vrhu mog ormara).

Verovatno mi je najdraže kada mi sedi u krilu dok programiram, produciram muziku ili samo sedim. Naravno, moram da budem savršeno miran da ne bih uznemirio uspavanu princezu.

Zapravo, iako se jasno vidi da je slika generisana pomoću AI-ja, prilično dobro je sačuvala izgled moje mačke sa originalne fotografije.

O samom sajtu

Ponosno ga pokreće WordPress, motor ispod haube za koji ljudi iz IT-ja vole da ti kažu da je „zastareo“.

Verovatno moja prva prava ljubav, WordPress je neverovatan alat o kome se ne govori mnogo. Zato hajde da pričamo o njemu.

Možda si pokušao da napraviš svoj sajt na Wixu, Weeblyju, Squarespaceu ili nečemu sličnom — dobro došao u klub, pokušao sam i ja. I da, jasno mi je zašto ih ljudi koriste: nedostatak znanja, nedostatak volje ili jednostavno zato što su dovoljno dobri za njihove potrebe.

Pa, WordPress, za razliku od svih tih servisa, nije servis već pokretač, a njegov kôd je besplatan i javno dostupan, dajući ljudima slobodu da od temelja oblikuju sajtove kako god žele.

Zato da — koristi WordPress. I da, u početku je pomalo komplikovan, ali vredi savladati ga!

Ovaj sajt ne bi postojao bez njih

Ovo su moja dva ljubimca, kodnih oznaka „Pluto“ i „Venus“, na kojima se hostuje ovaj sajt.

Ah, pa, povrh svega čime se bavim, uživam i u patnji zvanoj postavljanje i održavanje servera.

Da, slika jeste generisana pomoću AI-ja, ali dva servera koja vidiš na njoj zaista postoje. Samo nisu na istoj lokaciji, pa sam morao da AI-ju dam njihove fotografije i spojim ih u jednu sliku kako bi lakše mogao da zamisliš moj setup.

Oba koriste ogoljene verzije Linuxa, složene tunele, prosleđivanje portova i rutiranje (volim da te gađam tehničkim izrazima jer tako zvučim kao da znam o čemu pričam).

Ako se pitaš koji je server koji, gornji nosi oznaku „Venus“, a onaj ispod njega „Pluto“.

item.title: Company
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
I am flattered that you thought that this is a company or I own companies, but the reality is that I don't, well not yet at least.

There have been several ill attempts to make, listen carefully, "a foundation for the greater good of the open source and free software community".

Yes, I did try to make an organization or a foundation that helps preserve free software, knowledge, games, music, media for future generations, brilliantly named Free Knowledge Preservation Foundation, I even bought the domain fkpf.org.

And yes, I even made a Reddit post about it, and actually there was this guy that was really interested in helping me with the idea.

And guess what I did like a true man of my word, I ghosted him. So to the person I ghosted on Reddit, if you are reading this, I got carried away in other projects and maybe the FKPF was too ambitious, and I am truly sorry for not working with you.

I guess by now, reader, you have learnt that I like taking on ambitious projects and never finishing them, and hey, you are now on my site, a project I'll never finish, so smile for the camera, you are part of the history now.

item.title: Kompanija
item.content:encoded:
Polaskan sam što si pomislio da je ovo kompanija ili da posedujem kompanije, ali u stvarnosti nije tako — pa, bar ne još.

Bilo je nekoliko neslavnih pokušaja da napravim, slušaj sada pažljivo, „fondaciju za opšte dobro zajednice otvorenog koda i slobodnog softvera“.

Da, zaista sam pokušao da napravim organizaciju ili fondaciju koja pomaže da se slobodni softver, znanje, igre, muzika i mediji sačuvaju za buduće generacije, briljantno nazvanu Free Knowledge Preservation Foundation. Čak sam kupio i domen fkpf.org.

I da, čak sam napravio objavu o tome na Redditu, i zapravo je bio jedan lik koji je baš želeo da mi pomogne sa idejom.

I pogodi šta sam uradio, kao pravi čovek od reči — ghostovao sam ga. Zato, osobi koju sam ghostovao na Redditu, ako ovo čitaš: odvukli su me drugi projekti, možda je FKPF bio preambiciozan i iskreno mi je žao što nisam radio s tobom.

Pretpostavljam da si do sada, čitaoče, shvatio da volim da se prihvatam ambicioznih projekata i nikada ih ne završim. I hej, sada si na mom sajtu, projektu koji nikada neću završiti, zato se nasmeši kameri — sada si deo istorije.

Out Now!

*Well, it's technically not out yet since the album is unfinished and I haven't actually uploaded it to any streaming services. Not to mention the bad mix...

Unendlich

by Alex Dietrich & Nala the cat

Including the hits Unendlich and Anderswo, plus the fan favorite Flüstern!

*I am not German; none of the songs have German lyrics—or any singing, for that matter. I just thought giving the songs German names would be cool.

*Well, actually, the song Unendlich has some German in it, but it's just a spoken vocal, so I don't really classify it as lyrics. The spoken vocals are more of a mood and tone setter, I guess.

My musical role models

The unbelievable French duo that inspired me to start making music of my own.

Have you ever heard the song "Get Lucky"? (I'm guessing you have, unless you live under a rock.) Well, that was the creation of two French robots: Daft Punk.

Although it's their most popular song, it is hardly the best song they ever produced. Trust me: as a dedicated fan, I've listened to every song they ever made, including demos and unfinished tracks. (If my music sounded like their demos or unfinished tracks, I'd be the most popular artist in the world.)

I could talk about them for hours, and they probably deserve a separate page on my website, but I don't want to spoil what makes their music—and their entire story and history—so amazing.

I cannot recommend their albums enough if you haven't already listened to them!

What kind of music am I actually making?

I'd say French touch? Maybe? I mean that's what I'm aiming for.

Well yes, I am trying to create that French Touch sound, a song based on a loop, with surrounding elements coming in and out, that way the music doesn't sound repetitive, even though the loop is the core element.

Although my mixes are indeed bad, I think you know what that means - yes, for a change, I'm not using AI, unlike the rest of the website, to create music. I'm indeed creating music with my own two hands.

You can actually download all my music and listen to it, just click on the album art located at the top of this page and you'll see a list of songs.

And hey, if you really did listen to the songs, I want to take the time to say, from the bottom of my heart, I don't care if you didn't enjoy it.

What people said about my music

"The album "Unendlich" reminds me of Daft Punk, that nice French Touch feel, amazing production, and just overall thoughtful sound design."

- Alex Dietrich.

"Unendlich" producer.

"Meow, meow meow meow meow...*Dramatic pause* Meow meow meow meow, meow meow, meow. Meow meow meow, meow meow, meow. Purr..."

- Nala the cat.

"Unendlich" co-producer.

"Can someone already sign this guy? The amazing talent and the level of detail in sound design is out of this world. Alex Dietrich could be the next Daft Punk."

- No one, ever.

Literally no one, ever.

item.title: Muzika
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Dostupno sada!

*Pa, tehnički još uvek nije izašao jer album nije završen i zapravo ga nisam postavio ni na jedan streaming servis. Da i ne pominjem loš miks...

Unendlich

Alex Dietrich & Nala the cat

Uključuje hitove Unendlich i Anderswo, kao i miljenika publike Flüstern!

*Nisam Nemac; nijedna pesma nema nemački tekst — niti pevanje, kad smo već kod toga. Samo sam mislio da bi bilo kul da pesme imaju nemačke nazive.

*Doduše, pesma Unendlich ima nešto nemačkog, ali to je samo izgovoreni vokal, pa ga ne računam baš kao tekst. Rekao bih da taj govor više služi da postavi raspoloženje i ton.

Moji muzički uzori

Neverovatni francuski duo koji me je inspirisao da počnem da pravim sopstvenu muziku.

Jesi li ikada čuo pesmu „Get Lucky“? (Pretpostavljam da jesi, osim ako živiš ispod kamena.) E pa, nju su stvorila dva francuska robota: Daft Punk.

Iako je to njihova najpopularnija pesma, teško da je najbolja koju su ikada producirali. Veruj mi: kao posvećeni fan, poslušao sam svaku pesmu koju su ikada napravili, uključujući demo snimke i nedovršene trake. (Kada bi moja muzika zvučala kao njihovi demo snimci ili nedovršene trake, bio bih najpopularniji izvođač na svetu.)

Mogao bih satima da pričam o njima i verovatno zaslužuju posebnu stranicu na mom sajtu, ali ne želim da pokvarim otkrivanje svega što njihovu muziku — kao i čitavu njihovu priču i istoriju — čini toliko neverovatnom.

Ako već nisi poslušao njihove albume, ne mogu dovoljno da ih preporučim!

Kakvu muziku ja zapravo pravim?

Rekao bih French touch. Možda? Mislim, tome težim.

Pa, da, pokušavam da napravim taj French touch zvuk: pesmu izgrađenu oko muzičke petlje, sa pratećim elementima koji se pojavljuju i nestaju kako muzika ne bi zvučala repetitivno, iako je ta petlja njena osnova.

Iako su mi miksevi zaista loši, mislim da znaš šta to znači — da, za promenu, za razliku od ostatka sajta, ne koristim AI za pravljenje muzike. Zapravo je stvaram svojim dvema rukama.

Možeš da preuzmeš svu moju muziku i poslušaš je. Samo klikni na omot albuma pri vrhu ove stranice i videćeš listu pesama.

I hej, ako si zaista poslušao pesme, želim da odvojim trenutak i od srca ti kažem: nije me briga ako ti se nisu dopale.

Šta su drugi rekli o mojoj muzici?

"Album "Dietrich" me podseća na Daft Punk, taj čuveni French Touch osećaj, neverovatna produkcija, i sveukupnan i promišljen dizajn zvuka."

- Alex Dietrich.

Producent albuma "Unendlich".

"Meow, meow meow meow meow...*Dramatična pauza* Meow meow meow meow, meow meow, meow. Meow meow meow, meow meow, meow. Purr..."

- Nala, mačka.

Koproducent albuma "Unendlich".

"Dobro da li će neko više da potpiše ovog momka? Neverovatan talenat, i nivo detalja u dizajnu zvuka je abnormalan. Alex Dietrich bez sumnje sledeći Daft Punk."

- Niko, nikad.

Bukvalno niko i nikad.

Unendlich

Alex Dietrich

4 tracks · 11:39 · 2026

Pusti pesmu sa albuma iznad da otključaš ovu sekciju.

Da li si već kliknuo na neku moju pesmu?

Ako nisi, prvo klikni na neku pesmu. Nije bitno da li ćeš je slušati ili ne — onda se vrati ovde.

Jesi siguran da si kliknuo na neku moju pesmu? Poslednja šansa, druže. Šalim se — znam da jesi. Imam kamere svuda.

Dobro, sada kada si konačno kliknuo na neku moju pesmu, šta misliš? Dobra je, je l’ da?

Ozbiljno, hteo sam da klikneš na pesmu kako bih mogao da pokažem svoj custom plugin, „Now Playing” — plejer koji se pojavio pri dnu ekrana. Ima čak i full-screen režim. A mislim da bi trebalo da klikneš na omot dok si u full-screen režimu, čisto iz zabave.

Deluje poznato, je l’ da? Kao da koristiš Spotify, Apple Music ili šta god. I da, napravio sam ovaj plugin od nule samo da možeš da uživaš u mojim krš miksevima na najlepši mogući način.

U svakom slučaju, nemam ništa posebno da dodam; samo sam hteo da ti pokažem svoj plugin. Sada idi i poslušaj sve moje pesme.

DIMIPEDIA

0,1 godina slobodne enciklopedije

Spremite se da slušate kako se hvalim

Nije bilo nijednog dobrog razloga da od nule napravim klon Wikipedije.

Volim da pravim prenaglašene, nepotrebne WordPress dodatke, a „Dimipedia” nije izuzetak.

Postoji mnogo dodataka koji verovatno na svaki način bolje kloniraju Wikipediju i bolje su optimizovani, ali me to, naravno, nije sprečilo da napravim svoje prilagođeno rešenje.

Da li je dobar? To prepuštam vama da procenite. Ali po mom skromnom, objektivnom i nepristrasnom mišljenju, ovaj dodatak je remek-delo.

Slobodno istražite Dimipediju i upoznajte glavne aktere kroz njihove zvanične članke.

item.title: Filozofija
item.content:encoded:
Vratimo veb sebi

Neka se zna širom kraljevstva: korisnik mora da poseduje svoje podatke, svoj softver i svoj kutak Veba.

Do sada verovatno već razumeš moju ljubav prema otvorenom kodu i, što je još važnije, pokretu slobodnog softvera — osim ako je ovo prva stranica mog sajta koju si otvorio.

Važna napomena, čitaoče: slobodan softver ne znači da je besplatan; znači slobodu. Meni, doduše, ponekad znači i jedno i drugo!

Da bismo videli zašto je ovo važno za sve nas — i za one koji nisu tehnički potkovani — dovoljno je setiti se da su veliki delovi digitalnog sveta na koji se oslanjamo oblikovani pokretom slobodnog softvera i ljudima poput Richard Stallman.

Pravo da razumemo mašinu

Neka se zna: nijednoj osobi ne bi trebalo da bude potrebna dozvola da razume, proučava, menja ili deli softver koji oblikuje njen svet.

Čovek, mit, legenda, jedini i neponovljivi: Richard Stallman.

Krajnje je vreme, čitaoče, da odamo počast ovom neverovatnom čoveku koji je snažno oblikovao način na koji razmišljam o softveru uopšte.

Legenda o kojoj je reč neposredno je pomogla svima nama da uživamo u slobodama koje pruža softver — uključujući i softver na kojem rade sajtovi poput ovog, WordPress. Ovaj neverovatni bradati čovek stvorio je licence dovoljno snažne da svako može da proučava softver pod njima, deli ga, prilagodi sebi i od njega napravi nešto novo!

A zatim gradimo za opšte dobro

Neka filozofi raspravljaju o mašini. Neka je inženjeri grade — a ono što naprave neka služi svima nama.

Linux je jedna od stvari zbog kojih iskreno verujem u ono što ljudi mogu da izgrade zajedno. Počeo je kao hobi projekat u studentskom domu u Finskoj, delo nikog drugog do Linus Torvalds. Nedugo zatim postao je NAŠ projekat: ljudi doprinose, menjaju ga, uče iz njega i čine ga boljim.

Zašto je ovaj pingvin u smokingu toliko važan svima nama? Pa, dragi čitaoče, video ti to ili ne, Linux je svuda. I da: ako ovo čitaš na Android telefonu, upravo ga koristiš.

Čak i ako ovo čitaš na Windows računaru ili Apple uređaju, mnogi sajtovi — uključujući i ovaj — rade na Linuxu.

Gospodo, molim vas.

Možda se ne slažu oko razloga, ali se možda slažu u mnogo čemu više nego što se na prvi pogled čini — na kraju krajeva, i sam pingvin živi pod Stallmanovim GPL-om.

Pa, čitaoče, verovao ili ne, Linux koji možda poznaješ ima mnogo više ispod haube nego što se na prvi pogled čini. Rad Richarda Stallmana imao je dubok uticaj na GNU/Linux ekosistem koji danas poznajemo i volimo.

Iako mnogi Stallmana vide kao filozofa, on je i izuzetan programer. Pokrenuo je GNU projekat, koji obezbeđuje veliki deo slobodnog softverskog temelja neophodnog da potpuni GNU/Linux sistem bude moguć.

GNU-ovi alati, biblioteke i ideali pomogli su da se jezgro pretvori u upotrebljiv operativni sistem — i omogućili milionima ljudi da koriste, proučavaju, prilagođavaju i dele softver pod sopstvenim uslovima.

Moj skromni doprinos svetu

Nema operativnog sistema. Nema velike revolucije. Samo slobodan softver, napravljen za mali kutak sveta koji slučajno prilično dobro poznajem.

Tu ulazim u priču — na znatno manjoj pozornici. Ne pravim operativni sistem niti pokrećem revoluciju. Pravim softver za stoni tenis, mali kutak sveta koji slučajno prilično dobro poznajem.

Ovde slobodno znači obe vrste slobode. Slobodno kao sloboda govora: proučavaj ga, menjaj, deli, unapređuj. I slobodno kao besplatno pivo, jer jednostavan alat za vođenje turnira u stonom tenisu ne bi trebalo da zahteva pretplatu, paywall ili „Professional Ultra Mega Edition“ samo da bi radio svoj posao.

Iznad svega, podaci treba da ostanu u rukama zajednice koja ih stvara. Igrači igraju mečeve, klubovi ih organizuju, a zajedno stvaraju istoriju koju ti rezultati beleže. LibreTT je samo moj mali doprinos: slobodan softver, otvorena vrata i alat koji pripada ljudima koji ga koriste.

item.title: Philosophy
item.dc:creator: tradicije
item.content:encoded:
Take back the web

Let it be known throughout the realm: the user shall own their data, their software, and their corner of the Web.

By now, you probably understand my love of open source and, more importantly, the free-software movement—unless this is the very first page you have opened on my website.

Please note, reader: free software does not mean that it costs nothing; it means freedom. For me, though, it sometimes means both!

To see why this matters to all of us—including those who are not tech-savvy—consider this: much of the digital world we rely on was shaped by the free-software movement and figures such as Richard Stallman.

The right to understand the machine

Let it be known: no person should require permission to understand, study, change, or share the software that shapes their world.

The man, the myth, the legend, the one and only: Richard Stallman.

It's about time, reader, that we pay tribute to this amazing man that shaped the way I think about software in general.

The legend in question directly helped us all to enjoy the freedoms of software, website that said software powers like WordPress. This amazing bearded man created licenses so strong to ensure anyone can learn on the software with said license, share it, even take it as their own and create something new!

And then, we build for the greater good

Let the philosophers debate the machine. Let the engineers build it — and let what they build serve us all.

Linux is one of those things that makes me genuinely optimistic about what people can build together. Started at a dorm room in Finland as a hobby project by none other than Linus Torvalds, it quickly became OUR project, people contribute, change, learn, and make it better.

Why is this penguin in a tux so important for us all? Well, dear reader, see it or not, Linux is everywhere, and yes, right now, if you are reading this from an Android phone, you are using it.

Even if you are reading this from a Windows PC or an Apple device, most, if not all websites, including this one, run on said Linux.

Gentlemen, please.

They may disagree about the why, yet perhaps they agree on more than first appears — after all, the penguin himself lives under Stallman’s GPL.

Well, reader, believe it or not, the Linux you may know has far more under the hood than it first appears. Richard Stallman’s work had a profound influence on the GNU/Linux ecosystem we know and love today.

Although many see Stallman as a philosopher, he is also an exceptional programmer. He launched the GNU Project, which provides a vast part of the free-software foundation that makes a complete GNU/Linux system possible.

GNU’s tools, libraries, and ideals helped turn a kernel into a usable operating system — and made it possible for millions of people to run, study, adapt, and share software on their own terms.

My humble contribution to the realm

No operating system. No grand revolution. Just free software, built for the little corner of the world I happen to know rather well.

This is where I enter the story—on a considerably smaller stage. I am not building an operating system or starting a revolution. I build software for table tennis, one little corner of the world I happen to know rather well.

Here, free means both kinds of free. Free as in speech: study it, change it, share it, make it better. And free as in beer, because a simple tool for running a table-tennis tournament should not require a subscription, a paywall, or a “Professional Ultra Mega Edition” merely to do its job.

Above all, data should stay in the hands of the community that creates it. Players contest the matches, clubs organize them, and together they create the history those results record. LibreTT is simply my little contribution: free software, open doors, and a tool that belongs to the people who use it.
